name: WAKEFIT INNOVATIONS LTD
summary: Wakefit Innovations Limited manufactures and markets home furnishing products. Its products include mattresses, beds, coffee tables, study tables, office chairs, bookshelves, bedding, pillows, wardrobes, shoe racks, TV units, sofa sets, and towels. The company offers its products through multiple online marketplaces besides its own website. Wakefit Innovations Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
